local theme={s="cards"}
local function light(c) return c==color.YELLOW or c==color.WHITE end
local function inkOf(c)
if c==color.ACCENT then return color.ACCENT_INK elseif c==color.ACCENT_INK then return color.ACCENT end
return light(c) and color.BLACK or color.WHITE
end
local tiles,raw,pts={},nil,{}
local function tileInk(x,y,c,fill)
if theme.s~="klar" then return c end
if (not fill or c~=color.WHITE) and #pts<400 then pts[#pts+1]=x; pts[#pts+1]=y end
for i=#tiles,1,-1 do
local t=tiles[i]
if x>=t[1] and x<t[3] and y>=t[2] and y<t[4] then
local f,i=t[5],t[6]
if c==f or (f==color.ACCENT and c==color.ACCENT_TEXT) then return i end
if c==color.BLACK and not fill and not light(f) and f~=color.ACCENT_INK then return i end
if c==color.ACCENT_INK and f~=color.ACCENT then return light(f) and color.BLACK or color.WHITE end
return c
end
end
return c
end
local function klarHook()
if raw then return end
raw={text=draw.text,wrap=draw.wrap,line=draw.line,rect=draw.rect,circle=draw.circle,triangle=draw.triangle,icon=draw.icon}
draw.text=function(x,y,s,f,c,...) return raw.text(x,y,s,f,tileInk(x,y - 4,c),...) end
draw.wrap=function(x,y,w,s,f,c,...) return raw.wrap(x,y,w,s,f,tileInk(x,y,c),...) end
draw.line=function(a,b,c2,d,c) return raw.line(a,b,c2,d,tileInk((a+c2)//2,(b+d)//2,c)) end
draw.circle=function(x,y,r,c,f)
c=tileInk(x,y,c,f)
if f and theme.s=="klar" and r>=8 and #tiles<120 then tiles[#tiles+1]={x - r,y - r,x+r,y+r,c,inkOf(c)} end
return raw.circle(x,y,r,c,f)
end
draw.triangle=function(a,b,c2,d,e,f,c,fl) return raw.triangle(a,b,c2,d,e,f,tileInk((a+c2+e)//3,(b+d+f)//3,c),fl) end
draw.icon=function(n,x,y,z,c) return raw.icon(n,x,y,z,tileInk(x+z//2,y+z//2,c)) end
draw.rect=function(x,y,w,h,c,fill,r)
c=tileInk(x+w//2,y+h//2,c,fill)
if fill and theme.s=="klar" and w>=16 and h>=12 and #tiles<120 then tiles[#tiles+1]={x,y,x+w,y+h,c,inkOf(c)} end
return raw.rect(x,y,w,h,c,fill,r)
end
end
local function setStyle(s)
theme.s=s or "cards"
tiles,pts={},{}
if theme.s=="klar" then klarHook() end
if theme.s=="relief" or theme.s=="klar" then return "cards" end
return s
end
local function card(x,y,w,h,c,r,nobar)
if theme.s=="relief" then
r=r or 12
draw.rect(x+6,y+6,w,h,color.BLACK,true,r)
draw.rect(x,y,w,h,color.WHITE,true,r)
draw.rect(x,y,w,h,color.BLACK,false,r)
draw.rect(x+1,y+1,w - 2,h - 2,color.BLACK,false,r)
return
elseif theme.s=="klar" then
if not c or c==color.BLACK then c=color.ACCENT end
draw.rect(x,y,w,h,c,true,math.min((r or 18)+8,30))
return
end
r=r or 10
draw.rect(x,y,w,h,color.WHITE,true,r)
draw.rect(x,y,w,h,color.BLACK,false,r)
if not nobar then draw.rect(x+6,y+6,5,h - 12,c or color.ACCENT,true,2) end
end
local function panel(x,y,w,h,r,c)
c=c or color.BLACK
local big=w>=60 and h>=30
if theme.s=="relief" and big then
local s=5
local rr=math.max(2,math.min(r or 12,40,w//2,h//2))
local function sichel(cx,cy,a0,a1)
local n=5
for i=0,n - 1 do
local u,v=math.rad(a0+(a1 - a0)*i/n),math.rad(a0+(a1 - a0)*(i+1)/n)
local c1,s1,c2,s2=math.cos(u)*rr,math.sin(u)*rr,math.cos(v)*rr,math.sin(v)*rr
local function f(v) return math.floor(v+0.5) end
draw.polygon({f(cx+c1),f(cy+s1),f(cx+c1+s),f(cy+s1+s),f(cx+c2+s),f(cy+s2+s),f(cx+c2),f(cy+s2)},color.BLACK,true)
end
end
draw.rect(x+w,y+rr,s,h - 2*rr+s,color.BLACK,true)
draw.rect(x+rr,y+h,w - 2*rr+s,s,color.BLACK,true)
sichel(x+w - rr,y+h - rr,0,90)
sichel(x+w - rr,y+rr,-45,0)
sichel(x+rr,y+h - rr,90,135)
end
if theme.s=="klar" and big then
c=c==color.BLACK and color.ACCENT or c
for i=1,#pts,2 do
if pts[i]>x and pts[i]<x+w and pts[i+1]>y and pts[i+1]<y+h then
for k=0,2 do draw.rect(x+k,y+k,w - 2*k,h - 2*k,c,false,r) end
return
end
end
draw.rect(x,y,w,h,c,true,math.min((r or 12)+8,30))
return
end
draw.rect(x,y,w,h,c,false,r)
end
local function widgetFrame(box)
if theme.s~="relief" and theme.s~="klar" then return box end
local x,y,w,h=box.x+4,box.y+2,box.w - 14,box.h - 12
card(x,y,w,h,color.ACCENT,theme.s=="relief" and 12 or 18)
local pad=theme.s=="relief" and 14 or 8
local inner={}
for k,v in pairs(box) do inner[k]=v end
inner.x,inner.y,inner.w,inner.h=box.x+pad,box.y+8,box.w - pad - 16,box.h - 20
return inner
end
local function pillW(txt,font,h,minw)
return math.max(minw or 0,draw.measure(txt,font or "small")+h)
end
local function pill(x,y,w,h,c,txt,font,tc)
if txt then w=pillW(txt,font,h,w) end
local r=h//2
c=c or color.ACCENT
if theme.s=="relief" then
draw.rect(x+3,y+3,w,h,color.BLACK,true,r)
draw.rect(x,y,w,h,c,true,r)
draw.rect(x,y,w,h,color.BLACK,false,r)
elseif theme.s=="klar" then
draw.rect(x,y,w,h,c,true,r)
else
draw.rect(x,y,w,h,c,false,r)
tc=tc or (c==color.ACCENT and color.ACCENT_TEXT or c)
end
if txt then draw.text(x+w//2,y+h//2+8,txt,font or "small",tc or (c==color.ACCENT and color.ACCENT_INK or color.WHITE),"center") end
return w
end
local function pbar(x,y,w,h,frac,c)
frac=math.max(0,math.min(1,frac or 0))
c=c or color.ACCENT
local r=h//2
if theme.s=="relief" then draw.rect(x+3,y+3,w,h,color.BLACK,true,r) ; draw.rect(x,y,w,h,color.WHITE,true,r) end
draw.rect(x,y,w,h,color.BLACK,false,r)
local fw=math.floor((w - 4)*frac)
if fw>h - 4 then draw.rect(x+2,y+2,fw,h - 4,c,true,(h - 4)//2)
elseif fw>2 then draw.rect(x+2,y+2,fw,h - 4,c,true) end
end
local NAS_FILE="gast.txt"
local MAX_RULES=6
local HOURS={[24]=true,[72]=true,[168]=true,[336]=true}
local function T(ctx,de,en) return (ctx.lang=="en") and en or de end
local function parse(text)
local m={}
if text then
for k,ts,v in text:gmatch("([%w_]+)\t(%d+)\t([^\n]*)") do m[k]={ts=tonumber(ts),v=v} end
end
return m
end
local function serialize(m)
local keys={}
for k in pairs(m) do keys[#keys+1]=k end
table.sort(keys)
local out={}
for i=1,#keys do out[i]=string.format("%s\t%d\t%s",keys[i],m[keys[i]].ts,m[keys[i]].v) end
return table.concat(out,"\n")
end
local function merge(a,b)
for k,e in pairs(b) do
local x=a[k]
if x==nil or e.ts>x.ts then a[k]=e end
end
end
local function load_local() return parse(file.read("gast")) end
local function now_ts() return time.now() or 0 end
local function val(m,k) return m[k] and m[k].v or "" end
local function clean(t,maxlen)
t=tostring(t or ""):gsub("[%c]"," "):gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","")
if #t>maxlen then
local i=maxlen
while i>1 and (t:byte(i+1) or 0) & 0xC0==0x80 do i=i - 1 end
t=t:sub(1,i)
end
return t
end
local function state(ctx,m)
if ctx.cfg.always then return true,nil end
local u=tonumber(val(m,"until")) or 0
local now=now_ts()
if u<=0 then return false,0 end
if now==0 then return true,nil end
return u>now,math.max(0,u - now)
end
local function rules_of(m)
local r={}
for i=1,MAX_RULES do
local t=val(m,"r"..i)
if t~="" then r[#r+1]=t end
end
return r
end
local function welcome_of(ctx,m)
local w=val(m,"welcome")
if w~="" then return w end
return T(ctx,"Willkommen! Schön, dass ihr da seid.","Welcome! Great to have you here.")
end
local function left_text(ctx,left)
if left==nil then return ctx.cfg.always and T(ctx,"dauerhaft","permanent") or "" end
local d=left//86400
local h=(left%86400)//3600
local mi=(left%3600)//60
if d>=1 then
return string.format(T(ctx,"noch %d %s %d Std","%d %s %d h left"),d,d==1 and T(ctx,"Tag","day") or T(ctx,"Tage","days"),h)
end
if h>=1 then return string.format(T(ctx,"noch %d Std %d Min","%d h %d min left"),h,mi) end
return string.format(T(ctx,"noch %d Min","%d min left"),math.max(1,mi))
end
local function wifi_ssid(ctx)
local s=tostring(ctx.cfg.ssid or "")
if s~="" then return s end
local sys=system.get()
return (sys and sys.ssid) or ""
end
local function wifi_pass(ctx)
local p=tostring(ctx.cfg.pass or "")
if p~="" then return p end
local sys=system.get()
if sys and sys.pass and sys.ssid==wifi_ssid(ctx) then return sys.pass end
return ""
end
local function wifi_payload(ctx)
local ssid=wifi_ssid(ctx)
if ssid=="" then return nil end
local function esc(s) return (s:gsub('([\\;,:"])',"\\%1")) end
local sec=tostring(ctx.cfg.sec or "WPA")
if sec=="nopass" then return "WIFI:T:nopass;S:"..esc(ssid)..";;" end
return "WIFI:T:"..sec..";S:"..esc(ssid)..";P:"..esc(wifi_pass(ctx))..";;"
end
local function apply_cfg(ctx,m)
local w=clean(ctx.cfg.welcome,80)
local list=type(ctx.cfg.rules)=="table" and ctx.cfg.rules or {}
local rules={}
for i=1,#list do
local t=clean(list[i],70)
if t~="" and #rules<MAX_RULES then rules[#rules+1]=t end
end
local sig=w.."\n"..table.concat(rules,"\n")
local old=file.read("cfgsig")
if old==sig then return end
file.write("cfgsig",sig)
if old==nil and sig=="\n" then return end
local now=now_ts()
m.welcome={ts=now,v=w}
for i=1,MAX_RULES do
local t=rules[i] or ""
if t~="" or m["r"..i] then m["r"..i]={ts=now,v=t} end
end
end
function on_fetch(ctx)
local m=load_local()
apply_cfg(ctx,m)
local sync="local"
if storage.ready() then
local remote,err=storage.read("dir",NAS_FILE)
if remote==nil and err=="nicht gefunden" then remote="" end
if remote~=nil then
merge(m,parse(remote))
local s=serialize(m)
if s~=remote then
sync=storage.write("dir",NAS_FILE,s) and "ok" or "error"
else
sync="ok"
end
else
sync="error"
end
end
file.write("gast",serialize(m))
ctx.data.set("sync",sync)
if sync=="ok" then ctx.data.set("syncAt",now_ts()) end
return true
end
function on_action(ctx,name)
if name~="use_current" then return {ok=false,message="?"} end
local s=system.get()
local ssid=s and s.ssid
if not ssid or ssid=="" then
return {ok=false,message=T(ctx,"Das Gerät ist gerade mit keinem WLAN verbunden.","The device is not connected to a Wi-Fi right now.")}
end
return {
ok=true,
message=string.format(T(ctx,"Verbunden mit „%s“. Name übernommen. Das Passwort des Geräts wird automatisch verwendet, wenn das Passwortfeld leer bleibt.","Connected to “%s”. Name applied. The device Wi-Fi password is used automatically while the password field stays empty."),ssid),
options={{value=ssid,label=ssid}},
}
end
local function esc(t)
return (tostring(t):gsub('[%c"\\]',function(c)
if c=='"' then return '\\"' elseif c=="\\" then return "\\\\" end
return " "
end))
end
local function reply(status,body) return {status=status,body=body} end
local function state_json(ctx,m)
local active,left=state(ctx,m)
local rules=rules_of(m)
local rj={}
for i=1,#rules do rj[i]='"'..esc(rules[i])..'"' end
return string.format('{"active":%s,"left":%d,"always":%s,"welcome":"%s","rules":[%s],"ssid":"%s","sync":"%s"}',
tostring(active),left or -1,tostring(ctx.cfg.always and true or false),esc(val(m,"welcome")),table.concat(rj,","),
esc(wifi_ssid(ctx)),esc(ctx.data.get("sync") or "local"))
end
function on_http(ctx,req)
local q=json.decode(req.body or "")
if type(q)~="table" then return reply(400,'{"error":"JSON"}') end
local op=tostring(q.op or "list")
local m=load_local()
local now=now_ts()
local changed=false
if op=="start" then
local h=math.floor(tonumber(q.hours) or 0)
if not HOURS[h] or now==0 then return reply(400,'{"error":"Dauer oder Uhr"}') end
m["until"]={ts=now,v=tostring(now+h*3600)}
changed=true
elseif op=="stop" then
m["until"]={ts=now,v="0"}
changed=true
elseif op=="set" then
m.welcome={ts=now,v=clean(q.welcome,80)}
local list=type(q.rules)=="table" and q.rules or {}
for i=1,MAX_RULES do
local t=clean(list[i],70)
if t~="" or m["r"..i] then m["r"..i]={ts=now,v=t} end
end
changed=true
end
if changed then
file.write("gast",serialize(m))
local r=reply(200,state_json(ctx,m))
r.fetch=true
r.redraw=true
return r
end
return reply(200,state_json(ctx,m))
end
local function cut(text,maxw,font)
while #text>1 and draw.measure(text,font)>maxw do
local i=#text
while i>1 and (text:byte(i) & 0xC0)==0x80 do i=i - 1 end
text=text:sub(1,i - 1)
end
return text
end
local function fit(text,maxw,fonts)
for i=1,#fonts do
if draw.measure(text,fonts[i])<=maxw then return text,fonts[i] end
end
local f=fonts[#fonts]
return cut(text,maxw,f),f
end
local function sync_text(ctx)
local s=ctx.data.get("sync")
if s=="ok" then return T(ctx,"synchronisiert","synced") end
if s=="error" then return T(ctx,"Sync-Fehler","sync error") end
return T(ctx,"nicht synchronisiert","not synced")
end

draw.clear(color.WHITE)
local title=T(ctx,"Gast-Modus ist aus","Guest mode is off")

draw.clear(color.WHITE)

draw.clear(color.WHITE)
local y0=draw.top
local W,H=draw.width,draw.height
draw.text(28,y0+38,T(ctx,"Hausregeln","House rules"),"large",color.BLACK,"left")
draw.line(28,y0+52,W - 28,y0+52,color.BLACK)
local n=#rules
local rowH=math.min(64,(H - y0 - 90)//n)
local font=(style=="compact") and "large" or "normal"
for i=1,n do
local y=y0+64+(i - 1)*rowH
if style=="cards" then
panel(24,y,W - 48,rowH - 8,12)
elseif style=="flat" then
draw.line(28,y+rowH - 4,W - 28,y+rowH - 4,color.BLACK)
end
local cy=y+(rowH - 8)//2
draw.circle(52,cy,14,color.BLUE,true)
draw.circle(52,cy,14,color.BLACK,false)
draw.text(52,cy+7,tostring(i),"normal",color.WHITE,"center")
draw.text(80,cy+8,cut(rules[i],W - 80 - 44,font),font,color.BLACK,"left")
end
end
function on_draw(ctx,page)
if page==2 then return page_rules(ctx) end
return page_wifi(ctx)
end
function on_widget(ctx,box)
setStyle(ctx.cfg.style)
box=widgetFrame(box)
local style=setStyle(ctx.cfg.style) or "cards"
local m=load_local()
local active,left=state(ctx,m)
local cx=box.x+box.w//2
local payload=active and wifi_payload(ctx) or nil
if not active then
draw.text(cx,box.y+box.h//2+6,T(ctx,"Gast-Modus aus","Guest mode off"),"normal",color.BLACK,"center")
return
end
if not payload then
draw.text(cx,box.y+box.h//2+6,T(ctx,"WLAN-Name fehlt","Wi-Fi name missing"),"normal",color.BLACK,"center")
return
end
local ssid=tostring(ctx.cfg.ssid)
if box.h<90 or style=="compact" then
local q=math.min(box.h - 28,box.w - 16)
local side=draw.qr(payload,cx - q//2,box.y+4,q) or 0
draw.text(cx,box.y+box.h - 6,cut(ssid,box.w - 12,"small"),"small",color.BLACK,"center")
return
end
local q=box.h - 20
local side=draw.qr(payload,box.x+10,box.y+10,q) or q
local tx=box.x+10+side+14
local maxw=box.x+box.w - tx - 8
local lt=left_text(ctx,left)
local t1,f1=fit(ssid,maxw,{"normal","small"})
if box.h>=110 then
draw.text(tx,box.y+22,T(ctx,"Gäste-WLAN","Guest Wi-Fi"),"small",color.BLACK,"left")
draw.text(tx,box.y+50,t1,f1,color.BLACK,"left")
if ctx.cfg.sec~="nopass" and tostring(ctx.cfg.pass or "")~="" then
local t2,f2=fit(tostring(ctx.cfg.pass),maxw,{"normal","small"})
draw.text(tx,box.y+76,t2,f2,color.BLACK,"left")
end
if lt~="" then draw.text(tx,box.y+box.h - 8,cut(lt,maxw,"small"),"small",color.GREEN,"left") end
else
draw.text(tx,box.y+box.h//2 - 4,t1,f1,color.BLACK,"left")
if lt~="" then draw.text(tx,box.y+box.h//2+22,cut(lt,maxw,"small"),"small",color.GREEN,"left") end
end
end

help.de: Trage das WLAN ein, das Gäste nutzen sollen (am besten das Gastnetz deines Routers). Name und Passwort bleiben nur auf diesem Gerät gespeichert und werden nie über den Speicher oder die Handy-Seite verteilt. Gäste scannen den QR-Code mit der Handy-Kamera und sind verbunden.
help.en: Enter the Wi-Fi guests should use (ideally your router's guest network). Name and password only stay on this device and are never shared via storage or the phone page. Guests scan the QR code with their phone camera and are connected.

help.de: Willkommenstext und bis zu 6 Hausregeln (eine pro Zeile) kannst du hier eintragen. Sobald du etwas änderst, gilt es als neuester Stand und wird – mit externem Speicher – an alle InkBoards im Netzwerk verteilt. Änderungen über die Handy-Seite (QR-Code) bleiben möglich.
help.en: Enter a welcome text and up to 6 house rules (one per line) here. As soon as you change something it counts as the newest state and – with external storage – is shared with all InkBoards in the network. Changes via the phone page (QR code) remain possible.

helpTitle.de: Wie kommen die Regeln aufs Display?
helpTitle.en: How do the rules get on the display?

help.de: Mit externem Speicher (Einstellungen → Speicher; FTP, WebDAV oder Google Drive) zeigen alle InkBoards im Netzwerk denselben Gast-Modus samt Hausregeln: Start, Ende, Willkommenstext und Regeln liegen mit Zeitstempel in einer gemeinsamen Datei, der neuere Stand gewinnt. WLAN-Name und Passwort werden nie geteilt. Ohne externen Speicher arbeitet die App nur auf diesem Gerät.
help.en: With external storage (Settings → Storage; FTP, WebDAV or Google Drive) all InkBoards in the network show the same guest mode and house rules: start, end, welcome text and rules are kept with a time stamp in a shared file and the newer state wins. Wi-Fi name and password are never shared. Without external storage the app only works on this device.

help.de: Zeigt das Gäste-WLAN immer an, ohne Zeitbegrenzung (z. B. Ferienwohnung).
help.en: Always shows the guest Wi-Fi without a time limit (e.g. holiday flat).

help.de: Steht oben auf der WLAN-Seite (höchstens 80 Zeichen). Leer = Standardtext.
help.en: Shown at the top of the Wi-Fi page (max. 80 characters). Empty = default text.

help.de: Eine Regel pro Zeile, höchstens 6 (je 70 Zeichen).
help.en: One rule per line, max. 6 (70 characters each).

help.de: App-Speicher: ein eigener, getrennter Speicher (FTP, WebDAV oder Google Drive) nur für Apps. Einrichten unter Einstellungen → App-Speicher.
help.en: App storage: a separate storage (FTP, WebDAV or Google Drive) just for apps. Set it up under Settings → App storage.

help.de: Alle InkBoards mit demselben Ordner teilen sich Gast-Modus und Hausregeln.
help.en: All InkBoards with the same folder share guest mode and house rules.
